name: Bloodmaster's Ring
summary: The Bloodmaster sends you into the pit for a bout with Kronk. The crowd is already eager for the next round.

sections.title: The Next Bout
sections.body: The announcer is readying the crowd while Kronk waits as the next contestant. You are sent into the pit to face him, and the noise rises around the coming bout.

faq.answer: Kronk is the next contestant in the Bloodmaster's Ring. The announcer says they go way back and describes him as a strong brawler.

faq.q: What does the Bloodmaster want me to do?
faq.answer: The Bloodmaster sends you into the pit to face Kronk.
The announcer introduces Kronk as the next contestant, and the bout is set in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

faq.q: Where does the bout take place?
faq.answer: The bout takes place in the pit of the Bloodmaster's Ring.

faq.q: What happens after I enter the pit?
faq.answer: The announcer prepares to introduce Kronk while you ready yourself in the pit.

faq.q: What does the announcer say about Kronk?
faq.answer: The announcer says Kronk is not very bright, but is good at pummeling anything in his path.
